sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 11.8 grams of fat. Saturated fat is 4.5 grams, supporting a cleaner fat profile. Polyunsaturated fat is 0.4 grams, not adding much useful unsaturated fat, and for meats, fat quality is a major tradeoff. For meats, fat quality is the main tradeoff.

sections.title: Proteins
sections.narration: 26.1 grams of protein. That amount is useful enough to count. Essential amino acids score is 9 out of 9, making the protein useful for repair and maintenance, and it is still a strong secondary mark. For meats, protein quality matters a lot.

sections.title: Vitamins
sections.narration: Vitamin B12 is 100% daily value, useful for nerve and blood-cell support. Vitamin D is only 0% daily value, not bringing much bone or immune support, so that's a small downside for meats. For meats, vitamin B12 and vitamin D matter most.
